_notes.audience: Builders shipping AI features into BigCommerce ecommerce stores
_notes.frame: Historical prototype reel. Its generated media predates the fixed shopper policy and is not current runtime evidence.
_notes.publication_boundary: Do not regenerate or publish. Current evidence comes from scripts/capture-runtime-parity.mjs and still requires human visual review.
_notes.voice_choice: brian — American narrator. Tuned generate.mjs settings: stability 0.7, similarity 0.8, style 0.0 (default-ish, no theatrical variation).
_notes.tts_field: Optional per-scene override for narration only. Used here for 'Bealls' → 'Bells' pronunciation while the visible caption keeps the correct brand spelling.
_notes.em_dashes: Used sparingly — ElevenLabs reads em-dashes as long pauses, so reserve them for genuine breaks; prefer commas and periods for flow.

scenes.title: Historical prototype storefront
scenes.caption: Archived frame from the earlier Bealls-family prototype. It showed a shopper layout-generation concept that is no longer authorized. The current storefront keeps route scaffolds fixed and makes no shopper-paid model calls.
scenes.tts: Archived frame from the earlier Bells-family prototype. It showed a shopper layout-generation concept that is no longer authorized. The current storefront keeps route scaffolds fixed and makes no shopper-paid model calls.

scenes.title: Historical instrumentation
scenes.caption: Archived instrumentation from the model-layout prototype. The current dev view may report route, policy, persona inference, and named-zone provenance. It must not label fixed or fallback content as model-generated, and it does not grant shopper model authority.

scenes.title: Historical model reasoning
scenes.caption: This archived frame showed model-authored reasoning. Current shopper evidence records the effective policy, source, terminal, reference state, and trusted-rule provenance. It does not manufacture model explanations for fixed content.

scenes.title: The fixed category contract repeats
scenes.caption: Three clean reloads exercise the same fixed category policy. Shopper URLs cannot bypass caches or trigger a paid model call. This evidence checks repeatability; it does not claim external-reference visual preservation.

scenes.title: Historical operator dashboard
scenes.caption: Archived operator view from the earlier prototype. Signal and inference inspection remain separate from shopper publication authority. Historical generation and token panels do not prove that the current shopper runtime invokes a model.

scenes.title: Retired shopper refinement
scenes.caption: Historical refinement flow. The current POST /api/refine endpoint returns 403 because PLP and search zones are fixed. Shopper text cannot recompose a layout or trigger a paid model call.

scenes.title: Historical continuity concept
scenes.caption: Archived continuity concept. The current inference system can preserve approved session signals, but those signals do not unlock model composition. Any future customer-history input requires its own consent, data, and publication contract.

scenes.title: Fixed category policy
scenes.caption: Category routes keep the catalog grid and controls fixed. Their six named PLP zones execute through policy and terminate as approved fallback content or Hidden. No PLP zone currently grants model authority.

scenes.title: Rules-only product recommendations
scenes.caption: The product scaffold is fixed. Three recommendation zones may use the registered pdp-tag-overlap-v1 rule with server-approved catalog references. The other PDP zones remain fallback or Hidden. No PDP zone accepts shopper-triggered model output.

scenes.title: Fixed cart contract
scenes.caption: Cart line items, shipping progress, order summary, promo entry, and every named cart zone are fixed. The global cart drawer has no model-zone API call. The cart page records fallback or Hidden terminals without claiming engine provenance.

scenes.title: The closed renderer vocabulary
scenes.caption: This archived catalog is broader than current shopper authority. Current named-zone schemas accept only components the matching renderer can dispatch. Product IDs, assets, and destinations must also come from the server-approved closure.

scenes.title: Historical model-generation code
scenes.caption: Archived code frame from the whole-layout prototype. The current shopper runtime does not call this gateway path. Publication now requires a trusted route, exact named-zone schema, full asset and catalog closure, and an authorized source.

scenes.title: Separate brand contracts
scenes.caption: Bealls, Bealls Florida, and Home Centric have separate runtime policies, route availability, assets, and renderer fingerprints. A brand ID is not a license to reuse another brand's identity. Unknown IDs fail closed, and onboarding another merchant requires more than one configuration file.
scenes.tts: Bells, Bells Florida, and Home Centric have separate runtime policies, route availability, assets, and renderer fingerprints. A brand ID is not a license to reuse another brand's identity. Unknown IDs fail closed, and onboarding another merchant requires more than one configuration file.

scenes.title: One codebase, three bounded brands
scenes.caption: The three related brands share implementation code but keep separate visual identity and policy. Home Centric uses content-mode category and locator routes; storefront-only account, cart, checkout, product, search, and compare routes fail closed.
scenes.tts: The three related brands share implementation code but keep separate visual identity and policy. Home Centric uses content-mode category and locator routes; storefront-only account, cart, checkout, product, search, and compare routes fail closed.

scenes.title: Historical marketplace concept
scenes.caption: Archived integration concept. No Voucherify or shared shopping-agent authority is established by this repository. A future incentive provider would need its own authenticated data contract and shopper publication boundary.

scenes.title: Historical cost panel
scenes.caption: This archived panel measured the retired generation prototype. Its counts and cost estimate do not describe the current shopper runtime. Shopper routes now have zero authorized model families and cannot request freshness or paid execution.

scenes.title: Uncontracted future inputs
scenes.caption: Order history, customer cohorts, and external product feeds are roadmap inputs, not current runtime facts. Each would require consent, brand binding, versioned provenance, and a named policy decision before it could affect shopper output.

scenes.title: Unimplemented customer-history concept
scenes.caption: This is a historical concept frame, not a shipped webhook. The current runtime does not claim order-history ingestion, a sixty-percent family-shopper prior, or preloaded refinement. Those features remain uncontracted.

scenes.title: Unimplemented channel expansion
scenes.caption: Email, push, SMS, and in-app output are roadmap concepts. This repository contracts Bealls-family web routes and named zones only. It does not establish cross-channel schemas, consent, delivery, or publication authority.

scenes.title: Current boundary
scenes.caption: The current shopper boundary is fixed scaffolds, strict named-zone schemas, three trusted PDP rule families, and zero authorized model families. The internal parity matrix checks regression against pinned main. It does not prove external storefront preservation or clear the human visual gate.
